tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The background. Lapel: bottle green, about 60% of a piece. Star Glasses: hot pink, only inside an accent panel or on a small accent piece.

tokens.name: ground-deep
tokens.usage: Deeper panels and the sunburst field. The darkest colour in the system; there is no black.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: All main text. Cream on green is 7.3:1; deep green on pink is 5.5:1.

tokens.name: text-second
tokens.usage: Addresses, captions and secondary lines. Pistachio on green is 6.1:1; berry on pink is 5.2:1.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, days and times in tracked caps. Gold on green is 5.0:1; on pink, labels go deep green.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Star rows and the wordmark star. Gold foil on green, deep green on pink.

tokens.name: spark
tokens.usage: The one emotional line per piece (the italic aside). Pink on green is 4.5:1, so 21px and up.

tokens.name: stripe
tokens.usage: The satin band: pistachio on green, tangerine on pink.

tokens.name: ray
tokens.usage: Sunburst rays. The sunburst marks the concert only, so in practice it stays gold on green.

tokens.name: seam
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: stock
tokens.usage: Cream ticket and insert stock, in both themes.

tokens.name: stock-ink
tokens.usage: The only text colour on cream stock (7.3:1 / 12.8:1). Gold and pink never sit on cream.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name only. Once per piece, in `text`.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: One headline per piece or panel. Never below 32px: Shrikhand clogs when small.

styles.name: ticket-title
styles.usage: The featured event on a ticket or the sunburst stop.

styles.name: aside
styles.usage: The emotional line under a headline, in `spark`. One per piece.

styles.name: event-name
styles.usage: Event names in the itinerary, in `text`.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Days, times and kickers, all caps, in `label`, or `stock-ink` on a ticket.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Doors at seven. Dress like a rocket man.
styles.usage: Running text in `text`. Keep lines under 60 characters.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Eyebrow to the line it labels.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between stacked lines inside one block; gap between stars.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside tickets; between itinerary rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on screen.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page margin on screen and in print (about 1/2 inch on a 5x7 card).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Height of the striped band; space above a wordmark.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything by default: cards, bands, panels.

tokens.name: notch
tokens.usage: The clipped corners of tickets and the sunburst ticket. Corners are cut, not rounded.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Small badges only.

stripe.note: The satin band: pistachio stripes over lapel, finished with a scalloped edge.

tokens.name: stripe-width
tokens.usage: Each pistachio stripe.

tokens.name: stripe-gap
tokens.usage: Lapel showing between stripes.

tokens.name: scallop
tokens.usage: Scallop pitch along the band's bottom edge.
